ZONINGLOTDEVELOPMENTANDEASEMENTAGREEMENT THIS ZONING LOT DEVELOPMENT AND EASEMENT AGREEMENT (Agreement") made as of the d dday of May, 2007 by and between WENTWORTH HOTEL COMPANY, a New York partnership ("Owner"), having an office at 15 West 39"hn Street, 2nd Floor, New York, New York 10018, and EXTELL DIAMOND TOWER LLC, a Delaware limited liability company ("Developer"),having an address at 805 Third Avenue,Seventh Floor, New York,New York10022. WITNESSETH: WHEREAS, Developer is the owner of certain land, with the buildings and improvements to be constructed thereon, in the City of New York, Borough of Manhattan, generally known by street address as 57 West 46th Street, New York, New York, designated as Lot 11 inBlock 1262on the Tax Mapof the City,County and Stateof NewYork,as more particularly described on Exhibit A annexed hereto and made a part hereof (such land being replacements thereof permitted pursuant to the provisions of this Agreement, being herein called the “Developer Building,” and the Developer Land and the Developer Building being herein collectively called the “Developer Premises"); WHEREAS, Owner is the owner of certain land, with the buildings and improvements thereon, in the City of New York, Borough of Manhattan, generally known by streetaddressas59West46thStreet,NewYork,NewYork,designatedasLot9inBlock1262 on the Tax Map of the City of NewYork and more particularly described on Exhibit B annexed hereto and made a part hereof (said land being herein collectively called the “Owner Land,” said buildings and improvements, together with any future replacement thereof permitted pursuant to the provisions of this Agreement, being herein called the “Owner Building,”' and the Owner Land and the Owner Building being herein collectively called the“Owner Premises"); WHEREAS, Developer intends to (A) acquire and/or, by incorporation thereof into the Combined Zoning Lot (as hereinafter defined),utilize other Floor Area Development Rights (as hereinafter defined) or parcels of land or portions thereof that are contiguous with the Combined Zoning Lot or with each other for at least ten (10) linear feet, located in the County of New York, City and State of New York, in Block 1262 on the Tax Map, and (B) to merge the Combined Zoning Lot with the Additional Parcels to create an enlarged Combined Zoning Lot; WHEREAS, Developer desires to construct a new building (the “New Developer Building") on a development site which will include the Developer Premises (the “Development Site") with a bulk in excess of the bulk permitted to be constructed on the Development Site under the Zoning Resolution (as hereinafter defined)if the Development Site was considered as a separate and independent zoning lot;
